description.en: The region ID of the service.

description.zh: 查询终止时间，默认当前时刻。
description.en: The end time of the query range, in UTC. The default value is the current time.

description.zh:
事件类型：

- Normal：正常事件。
- Warning：异常事件。
description.en:
The event type. Valid values:

- Normal: a normal event.

- Warning: a warning event.

description.zh: 服务实例的名字。如何获取实例名称，请参见[ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~)。
description.en: The name of the service instance. To obtain this name, see [ListServiceInstances](~~412108~~).

description.zh: 服务事件列表的页码，默认为1。
description.en: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的事件数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of events to return per page. Default value: 100.

description.zh: 服务对应名称。如何获取服务名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
description.en: The name of the service. To obtain this name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

description.zh: 查询起始UTC时间。默认为7天前。
description.en: The start time of the query range, in UTC. The default value is 7 days ago.
